content.text: [Email Dr. Sarah Chen → VendorX Legal Thu Jan 12 2026] DPA Review — Art.28 Requirements. Identified gap: DPA v1.2 §3.4 sub-processor authorisation mechanism is missing. GDPR Art.28(3)(d) requires prior specific or general written authorisation. Penalty risk: €10,000,000 or 2% of global annual turnover (whichever higher).

Logged. GDPR Art.28(3)(d) sub-processor written authorisation gap confirmed. Penalty framework: €10,000,000 or 2% of global annual turnover per GDPR Art.83(4). This is a HIGH-risk compliance gap requiring remediation before DPA execution.

[Email VendorX Legal → Dr. Sarah Chen Sat Jan 14 2026] Re: DPA Review. We acknowledge the sub-processor gap. Will provide revised DPA with general authorisation mechanism with MSA v2.4 package. Also confirm: CISG exclusion in §12.3 is valid under Dutch law. VendorX agrees CISG does not apply.
Noted. VendorX acknowledges the sub-processor gap and will address in v2.4. Both parties' counsel confirm CISG exclusion is valid. CISG does not apply.
